args.sql:
CREATE VIEW environmental_sustainability AS
SELECT 
    e.envhealthregistry,
    e.envdistref,
    e.envimpactrate,
    e.wastemanagementstate,
    e.recyclepct,
    e.carbontons,
    e.renewenergypct,
    e.waterqualityindex,
    e.sanitationcoverage,
    ROUND(CAST(e.carbontons * (1 - e.renewenergypct / 100.0) + (100 - e.recyclepct) * 0.5 AS numeric), 2) AS environmental_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN e.carbontons * (1 - e.renewenergypct / 100.0) + (100 - e.recyclepct) * 0.5 < 50 THEN 'Sustainable'
        WHEN e.carbontons * (1 - e.renewenergypct / 100.0) + (100 - e.recyclepct) * 0.5 < 100 THEN 'Moderate Impact'
        ELSE 'High Impact'
    END AS impact_category
FROM environmentandhealth e;
